title: CIA Whistleblower Testifies Before Senate on Alleged Lab Leak Cover-Up
detail: Senior CIA operations officer James Erdman III testified before the Senate Homeland Security Committee on May 13, 2026, alleging that CIA scientific analysts concluded multiple times between 2021 and 2023 that a Wuhan laboratory leak was the most likely COVID-19 origin — but that CIA leadership repeatedly altered those findings in official intelligence summaries and actively obstructed a joint CIA/ODNI investigation. The CIA dismissed the hearing as 'political theater.' Democratic senators boycotted the proceedings. The testimony adds to a growing body of congressional investigation supporting the lab leak hypothesis, following the House Select Subcommittee's 520-page final report in December 2024.

media.caption: CIA whistleblower James Erdman III testifies before Senate that lab leak intelligence was suppressed by agency leadership
